name: cli-session-single-writer-receive-order
body:
The session is the single writer of the buffered node files and the live database. It applies routed mutations in receive order, and a replayed client identifier returns the cached reply for that request and applies it at most once.

ACCEPTANCE:
- Two mutations routed to the session apply in the order the session receives them, so the final buffered state reflects that order.
- A request that replays a previously seen client identifier returns the cached reply and leaves the buffered state and the live index unchanged.
